prerequisites: Knowledge based on previous technology seminars.

learning_outcomes.text: The course deals with the theory and engineering methods of a manufacturing design.

syllabus_topics: Technological design, elements and functional bonds, decomposition of production systems
Analysis of input data for the production system design
Use of predefined times to increase productivity
Production management, Supply chain management, SW
Warehouse automation, industry 4.0, VR in warehouses
Entry, technological process of production, choice of semifinished product
Determination of production and non-production times (TA, TB, TC)
Placement of production equipment into existing layout
Plant Simulation - device deployment and material flow simulation
